power_reduction.note: Unreachable by construction: the 50-75x headline in SUMMARY_HIGH_LEVEL_ARCHITECTURE assumes 0.5 mW quiescent power, which ARCH_7's own 'CRITICAL CORRECTIONS' table supersedes with 50 mW. At 50 mW quiescent the ceiling is 600/(50+3) ~ 11x -- ARCH_7's own corrected formula. The SNN compute path itself still beats the CNN by ~18x.
